title: Test Runtime Dependency and Disposable Environment Baseline
supersedesRiskNote: R-072 (RISK_REGISTER.md) recorded server/src/tests/ at 96 files vs F0-005's 72 (measured 2026-07-28 against a d0311636-era HEAD). This document's own fresh count against current HEAD 08f2eaf finds 105 backend test files (97 flat + 8 in server/src/tests/dbVerification/), i.e. drift has continued past R-072's own snapshot. This is a further confirmation of R-072, not a resolution of it. R-072 is NOT closed by this document (out of this task's allowed scope).
methodologyNote: CodeGraph was checked via ToolSearch before starting and was not available in this task's execution environment (no matching tool found), consistent with F1-001's own §0 disclosure. Per this task's own fallback instruction, no repository-wide replacement scan was performed; targeted Grep/Glob/Read inspection was used instead, scoped to server/src/tests, server/src/services, server/src/utils, src test directories, .github/workflows, and repo-root for Docker/Compose artifacts. A subagent performed the bulk of the file-diff and per-new-file classification pass; every count the subagent reported was independently spot-checked in this task's own shell against the live worktree (find/grep/node -e counts) before being written into this file — see F1-002-P2_TEST_RUNTIME_DEPENDENCY_BASELINE.md §2 for the exact verification commands and their output.
